episodes.title: Psalm 46:5
episodes.summary: Confused but excited by her newfound abilities, Ava soon realizes she's in over her head, but her need for a helping hand may be a blessing in disguise.

episodes.title: Proverbs 31:25
episodes.summary: After tasting the good life with JC, Ava crashes a swanky tech party with his friends. Mary goes gunning for the people behind the attack on her sisters.

episodes.title: Ephesians 6:11
episodes.summary: Ava takes her first steps toward understanding the halo's power, but a baptism by fire at the hands of the Order leaves her feeling burned.

episodes.title: Ecclesiasticus 26:9-10
episodes.summary: As Ava contemplates starting over, she recalls being left to the tender mercies of the orphanage. The Sister Warriors suit up for a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Matthew 7:13
episodes.summary: While Mary squares off with Sister Lilith, Ava begins to open up to JC, and Jillian Salvius fires a warning shot at the Church.

episodes.title: Isaiah 30:20-21
episodes.summary: Ava experiences a come-to-Jesus moment courtesy of Mary, who pulls no punches as she shows her just how many souls have their own cross to bear.

episodes.title: Ephesians 4:22-24
episodes.summary: Hoping to find some answers, Ava puts her faith in science. Meanwhile, Cardinal Duretti's machinations sow seeds of dissension inside the Order.

episodes.title: Proverbs 14:1
episodes.summary: Secrets are revealed and a Sister Warrior mysteriously returns to the fold as Ava and her allies attempt to keep a sacred object out of the wrong hands.

episodes.title: 2 Corinthians 10:4
episodes.summary: Infiltrating the Vatican to find a tomb hidden deep underground for a millennium? Hell, Ava may need a miracle to pull off this mission.

episodes.title: Revelation 2:10
episodes.summary: In shock over the contents of the tomb, Ava no longer knows what — or who — to believe as she tries to divine the true history of the halo.

episodes.title: Galatians 6:4-5
episodes.summary: Ava and Beatrice jump into action when they meet an ally eager to take down a self-proclaimed prophet and his followers. Tragedy strikes at the convent.

episodes.title: Colossians 3:9-10
episodes.summary: A mysterious nun makes contact with the OCS, while Adriel proposes a partnership to the pope. Lilith turns to an unexpected source for help.

episodes.title: Luke 8:17
episodes.summary: After the Order sends out an urgent call, Beatrice and Ava connect with old friends in Madrid and stop by a museum. Jillian investigates an anomaly.

episodes.title: Corinthians 10:20-21
episodes.summary: As a bizarre plague sweeps the city, Ava uncovers new revelations about Miguel — and Adriel's methods. Lilith explores new possibilities.

episodes.title: Mark 10:45
episodes.summary: Seeking Lilith's whereabouts, the sisters and Miguel visit Jillian. An unnerving discovery upsets Camila. Conflict erupts over Adriel at a conclave.

episodes.title: Isaiah 40:31
episodes.summary: The Order and their allies prepare for a showdown against Adriel at his new cathedral, but learn their adversaries have been making plans of their own.

episodes.title: Psalms 116:15
episodes.summary: After an intense battle, Ava's halo saves a life, while one of Adriel's followers has a crisis of faith. Camila finds herself behind enemy lines.

episodes.title: Jeremiah 29:13
episodes.summary: Ava visits the other realm and returns with a new plan to end Adriel's unholy charade — but it will require superhuman strength and painful sacrifices.
